evidence.reason: The source validator permits true null or blank warm-up values but rejects malformed non-empty text, infinity, and out-of-range finite values.
Runtime validation and bounded scaling use non-null conversion checks; tests cover malformed text and true NaN separately at tests/unit/test_fuzzy_scaling.py:117-130 and :197-209.
The manifest override path validates registered on-chain columns for malformed values, infinity, missing finite values, and [-1, 1] violations before returning the manifest.
Fresh and cached train/validation frames are range-validated before train-fitted scaling is applied; manifest edge cases are covered at tests/unit/test_fuzzy_scaling.py:133-161.
RB output stamps the current digest and reapplies it after extra metadata is merged, including strategy_contract and provenance copies at lines 564-570.
Output_Writer.write reconciles the current digest into recognized nested contracts before writing; stale top-level and nested copies are tested at tests/unit/test_output_writer.py:705-754.
Phase 5 requires at least one digest and rejects every present copy that differs from the current digest.

No-df recovery loads the source through Data_Loader with drop_tail=False. A valid 30-feature raw tape therefore retains terminal rows whose forward labels are NaN; those rows are passed to Phase 2 at lines 4530-4531.

CPUBacktestEngine rejects non-finite label_open_next. The Phase 2 wrapper catches that initialization failure and returns an empty pool at run_pipeline.py:3603-3626, after which run_phase2 deletes the LWC archive at :4439-4442 instead of rebuilding it.
load_mtf_archive_payload rejects a JSON list before optional schema validation, so legacy list-shaped archives cannot be loaded.
Both MTF archive loading APIs are exercised against a legacy list payload and expected to fail closed.
Tests cover missing feature digest, list payloads, stale archive rebuilds, missing archive_hash rebuild, and no-df LWC recovery.
A 30-feature same-shape pool is tested for missing and wrong digest sidecars through direct load_pool entry points.

checks.evidence: Two fail-closed contract paths remain incomplete: skip_if_valid calls load_pool without feature_infos, and no-df LWC recovery passes an untrimmed full source tape into a label-validating Phase 2 engine.

The requested tests exist, but the no-df recovery test replaces the source loader with an all-finite synthetic frame and stubs evolution; it cannot expose the real drop_tail=False label failure. No test checks skip_if_valid with a missing or mismatched feature digest sidecar.

The pool skip path is called by Pipeline_Orchestrator._load_phase2_outputs and _run_phase2 at run_pipeline.py:3027-3066 and :3538-3573. Graph tracing found 33 inbound skip_if_valid callers and the change impact contains 278 reachable nodes across Phase 2, RB, MTF, data, and validation modules.

Pool digest stamping failures are swallowed at phase2_rule_pool.py:4021-4026 and :4472-4477, while the production resume path does not enforce the sidecar. This creates an internally inconsistent freshness contract.
The production changes and tests are within the declared unit-3 runtime-contract and lineage scope; no unrelated production file change was found.

The review package reports deterministic verification PASSED and 6/6, and git diff --check passed. Independent pytest rerun was not possible because the shell permission policy denied the required .venv pytest command.
git status --short showed only untracked .opencode/ artifacts; no workspace changes outside .opencode were present.

findings.title: Production pool resume skips feature-digest validation
findings.description: skip_if_valid calls load_pool without feature_infos, so the feature-contract sidecar is not checked. The pipeline callers at run_pipeline.py:3063 and :3539 can therefore accept an inconsistent pool when its identity sidecar still matches, including a missing or mismatched digest sidecar. The digest writer itself only logs failures at phase2_rule_pool.py:4021-4026 and :4472-4477. Pass feature_infos through the skip path or validate the sidecar there, and add missing/mismatched skip tests.

findings.title: No-df LWC recovery cannot rebuild from a real full source tape
findings.description: _load_mtf_source_tape deliberately requests drop_tail=False. Once the source has the required 30 features, the terminal TAIL_DROP_ROWS rows still have NaN forward labels (data/labels.py:32-33; data/loader.py:526-541), but CPUBacktestEngine rejects them at backtest/cpu_engine.py:720-727. _run_phase2 catches the failure as an empty pool and run_phase2 removes the stale LWC archive, so recovery deletes the old artifact without producing a rebuilt pool. Trim/prepare the source for Phase 2 while preserving any full-tape use for higher-timeframe discovery.

findings.title: Recovery tests do not cover the real source-label boundary
findings.description: The no-df recovery test injects _make_30col_training_frame, whose label columns are finite for every row, and stubs evolution. It cannot detect the actual Data_Loader drop_tail=False plus CPUBacktestEngine failure. The pool tests likewise exercise load_pool(feature_infos=...) but not skip_if_valid with a missing or wrong digest sidecar. Add integration coverage for both production paths.

notes: Independent adversarial task review. Implementer claims and sealed verification were treated as unverified. No production code was edited. Fresh pre-impact is required before the next fix-loop implementer.
